title: Autofahrer fährt E-Scooter-Fahrer an – 22-Jähriger im Krankenhaus

extraction.summaryEn: A car driver turned left against a ban and collided with an e-scooter rider crossing the road at about 1:40 a.m. The 22-year-old e-scooter rider was seriously injured and taken to hospital; the driver was not hurt.
